cases.testName: project Goal list exposes live snapshots across sessions without mutating either Goal
cases.expected: The project index shows both session-local live Goal snapshots, marks the current session, and leaves both exact persisted states unchanged.

cases.testName: project Goal list can inspect another session by Goal id prefix without adopting it
cases.expected: A session with no Goal can inspect a foreign live Goal by id prefix without creating, adopting, pausing, or rewriting any Goal state.

cases.testName: Goal audit explains an active completion gate without mutating or pausing the Goal
cases.expected: The audit explains why the current Goal is not completion-ready while preserving the exact persisted live snapshot and command ownership.

cases.testName: Goal audit keeps a completed proof ledger inspectable without re-entering completion
cases.expected: A completed Goal is reported as completed with its current-revision host/verifier proof ledger instead of being misreported by re-running the pre-completion gate.
